opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn 2026 round

amount.raw: Maximum grant up to £20,000 (up to £5,000 for conferences, lectures and publications; up to £2,500 for research and travel grants)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) for most categories; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for Research and Travel grants
opportunities.summary: Grants support exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, research, publications and conferences related to sculpture.
